trigger: planted/corrupt HKLM UpgradeCodes tree (20000 subkeys x 256 names) or 5000 products with 4096-char values; needs a registry writer (admin/SYSTEM)
summary: No aggregate cap on the UpgradeCodes by_product map (~5M entries, ~1 GB) and none on RecordSet/render bytes (~430 MB worst case); per-value bounds hold but not in aggregate. list_inventory runs on the daily sync (E0), bounded only by the 60 s sync time_limit. Also raised as pd-1 and sre-2.

trigger: a malformed or planted cached package that makes msi.dll fault (SEH/AV is not caught by catch(...)); the file lives under <windir>\Installer (admin-writable only)
summary: In-process OLE compound-file parse by msi.dll in the SYSTEM agent: a parser fault kills the agent, not just the worker. Surface is disclosed in the Gate 1 summary but the crash-isolation residual is not stated in README caveat 5. Native label NICE disagreed with the derived MEDIUM.

trigger: admin plants Installer\CON.msi plus a LocalPackage value pointing at it
summary: package_path_allowed does not reject reserved DOS device leaf names (CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1-9/LPT1-9); MsiOpenDatabaseW resolves the Win32 path (hang bounded by the 5 s deadline and the single slot).

trigger: a later edit adds MsiViewModify/ApplyTransform/Merge/Import/Export or MsiSourceList*
summary: The forbidden-Installer-API pin is a 9-prefix deny-list over four hand-listed files; for msi_database_read.cpp an allow-list of the six Msi* calls it uses is stronger. Raised independently by security-guardian and quality-engineer.

trigger: reader trusts the changelog/yaml sentence
summary: "no reparse point is followed" over-claims: the plugin's own NtCreateFile open follows none and pins the leaf, but MsiOpenDatabaseW re-resolves the checked path (README caveat 5 states this honestly).

trigger: reader uses the banner to find the registry/db column boundary
summary: Banner says the first five columns after the code are registry values; the renderer emits seven (README :164 is right).

trigger: reader trusts the changelog sentence
summary: "a collector that predates the sixth token ignores it" is false: the pre-change adapter rejected a 6-token row. Not an old-peer finding; it removes a false claim. Raised by docs-writer and enterprise-readiness (ent-4).

trigger: sam-46-attrs lands first or together
summary: Sentences saying the collector ignores/does not store the sixth token and that the server hashes it into instance_key go false when sam-46-attrs (which stores it as the upgrade_code attribute) lands; the merge of test_inventory_sync.cpp keeps a now-false characterisation (cons-1). Merge-order checklist item.

trigger: reader trusts 'reserved slots 13-14, #5186'
summary: CARRIED obligation (gate-adjudication.log): the stale slot sentence is in a paragraph this diff edits and was not fixed.

trigger: this PR lands without sam-46-attrs
summary: CONDITIONAL: the installed-software routed row names ADR-0016 + inventory.md as update obligations; this diff changes the adapter and the inv| wire. No finding if the sibling (which carries both updates) lands first or together; I7 SHOULD otherwise.

trigger: reader of README :164/:173
summary: README says a Property value over 4,096 fails its read (true only for the five wanted rows) and the status table says every Products key was read (non-GUID subkeys are skipped).

trigger: reader of the definition/agent_registry text
summary: yaml list_inventory version column omits windows:msi_upgrade_map:<rc>; stale 'leaves publisher empty'; local_package column and changelog omit withheld:user_path; the yaml and agent_registry descriptions omit that the Windows leg is not yet verified against a real capture (ent-1). Raised by docs-writer, consistency-auditor (cons-3) and enterprise-readiness.

trigger: reader provisions the virtual service account on the strength of 'default'
summary: Row leads with 'default' for Windows while the S-1-5-18 UserData read is unmeasured and may be refused; sibling rows lead with 'Not yet measured'.

trigger: maintenance
summary: Third hand-rolled single-flight slot (DismSlot, bundle_id_read atomic_flag, SingleFlightSlot). Keep two for this PR; a shared agents/shared primitive is a follow-up.

trigger: n/a
summary: Question (code-review Q3 / docs-writer doc-6): does the agent-core detached-worker primitive need a routed-concern row? Architect determination: no (a fourth instance of an existing pattern; no row names msi_packages). Not a missing required doc under items 4/6.

trigger: agent stop while a package read is wedged, with DISM also wedged
summary: Bounded quiesce waits up to 10 s serially after DISM's 34 s in the teardown block no watchdog covers; unlike DISM it logs no residue. SRE: +10 s max alone (under the 30 s STOP_PENDING hint), 44 s only with both wedged; clean-but-late stop, no data loss.

trigger: n/a
summary: Gate 1 ledger claimed this is the only production sleep_for poll; windows_optional_features_plugin.cpp:353 has the same. The Resource Ledger written by this run is corrected.

trigger: Windows only: executed view closed with MsiCloseHandle and no MsiViewClose
summary: Unverified whether closing the view handle without MsiViewClose leaks; believed not. Resolve on the Windows leg; optionally add the one-line MsiViewClose.

trigger: a Windows SKU with no msi.dll (Nano Server / WinPE) loads agent-core
summary: Agent-core now has a hard load-time import of msi.dll (previously only the msi_packages plugin); dism_bounded_call resolves DismApi at run time behind api_available(). No repo doc names a SKU without msi.dll as supported, so E6 cannot be shown and the I5-to-HIGH raise (ordinary request path) is not applied.

trigger: junctioned <windir>\Installer or a non-X:\ windows dir
summary: Every row reads package_path_refused while the status stays supported; also up-2: a sharing violation from an Installer/AV write handle maps to the same reason.

trigger: profile folder outside ProfilesDirectory with a non-ASCII name whose case differs in the stored path
summary: Privacy fold is ASCII-only (NTFS uses $UpCase); same family as adversarial M1.

trigger: a regression that releases the slot in the TimedOut arm with a hung package
summary: The zero-deadline case accepts TimedOut or Completed so it cannot observe 'a timed-out worker keeps the slot'; no TimedOut case runs on any OS. Not offered as closure evidence for a blocking finding, so not the false-green floor.

trigger: the 64-call bounded-call ceiling is hit once
summary: The Rejected arm (caller-side slot.release()) has no test; removing it leaves installer_records permanently busy. Needs an injectable worker/ceiling seam.

trigger: a throw inside the worker
summary: Slot release on the worker-throw path is not exercised (only the Exception token mapping is).

trigger: shutdown while a worker is abandoned
summary: The bounded 2x5 s read_in_flight() quiesce and concurrent teardown have no test (Windows-lane test with the slot held asserting shutdown returns within the bound).

trigger: adding a forbidden call in an unscanned file or an unlisted name
summary: Lexical scan covers 4 hand-listed files (not msi_packages_inventory.hpp) and a short deny-list; same as sec-4.

trigger: loaded shared runner or slow Installer cache scan
summary: Two live Windows cases each dispatch installer_records (up to 45 s) with no efficiency justification block; agent shard C already runs 184-240 s of 480 s; wait_free() in the database tests is unbounded.

trigger: n/a
summary: The 'byte-identical on repeated calls' case renders a pure function twice and cannot observe time dependence; determinism is structural (registry-only map).

trigger: removing the / ? " < > | predicates or the drive-letter alpha check
summary: Path-gate revert-survivors: only ':', '*' and control characters are tested; NtCreateFile rejects the rest anyway.

trigger: an exception thrown in do_installer_records
summary: Catch envelope reports UNAVAILABLE with a constrained status row; pre-existing shape, newly reachable by the new action. No change required.

trigger: dispatch while the process-wide bounded-call ceiling is saturated
summary: A Rejected read is reported as msi_db:busy, while the ReadStatus doc and yaml distinguish refused from busy.

trigger: registry reorders subkeys
summary: Output order follows registry enumeration order (alphabetical in practice for NT hives); sorting is optional.

trigger: merge of sam-46-attrs and this branch in either order (textual conflict in test_inventory_sync.cpp)
summary: This branch asserts a valid-GUID 6th token maps to the same row as five tokens; sam-46-attrs maps it to attributes=upgrade_code, so the assertion is false after the merge and a conflict resolver could keep the wrong side. Merge-order checklist item with doc-3. Impact I9: the stale assertion fails visibly (red test) on the merged tree, it is not a false green.

trigger: reader of tokens
summary: windows:installer_records:enum:<rc> is also emitted for failed InstallProperties opens and value reads, not only enumeration; narrower name than use.

trigger: any non-absent fault on HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Installer\UpgradeCodes (realistic: ERROR_KEY_DELETED 1018 when the Installer deletes a subkey between open and enum; ACL denial is implausible today)
summary: A map read fault constrains the whole msi list_inventory section: collect() puts it in property_failure, the roster is constrained, adapt_pkg_inventory clears the entries and the sync sends a status-only section, so new installs/removals stop reaching msi_packages.list_inventory until the fault clears, for a token that nothing stores in this PR. The plan ruled 'no row is sent with a token emptied by a fault' (instance_key churn once stored). installed_apps still carries MSI products. Derived by the I6 base MEDIUM; native SHOULD.

trigger: an uninstall/recache/patch that deletes or replaces the exact cached package inside the (<=5 s, per-package, non-overlapping) FILE_SHARE_READ hold
summary: The hold (CF-1-4) denies write and delete sharing, so a concurrent Installer operation on that package can get ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION; whether the MSI engine fails the transaction (1603) or only logs and leaves the cache file is unverified. MANDATORY INVESTIGATION: resolve on the Windows leg (loop installer_records while running msiexec /fv and /x on a test product, assert exit 0 and no sharing violation in the MSI log).

trigger: a package read that never returns
summary: A hung MsiOpenDatabaseW pins one worker and the slot for the process lifetime; every later dispatch answers msi_db:busy (rows deadline_skipped, registry columns still emitted); the token cannot tell a 5 ms transient from a permanent wedge; no spdlog line, counter, residue log, or README recovery sentence (restart the agent). Merged with sre-1 and ent-2.

trigger: two concurrent installer_records dispatches
summary: The second dispatch gets Busy on its first package and latches reads_stopped, so every database column is skipped though the first read takes milliseconds; the first dispatch is unaffected.

trigger: remaining budget of a few ms
summary: read_database(min(5 s, remaining)) with remaining ~1 ms near-certainly times out on a healthy package and pins the slot; used counts database time only; open_file_no_reparse has no deadline.

trigger: every package unreadable (broken msi.dll) or one product with a non-string/oversized registry value
summary: Status stays supported with empty database columns and no aggregate token when every read fails; one record with a REG_DWORD or over-4096 value constrains the device's whole answer every day (honest by design).

trigger: an install path outside the profile roots that still names a person (redirected profile, D:\Users\..., UNC)
summary: The privacy rule is a deny-list (path under a profile root); the ADR-0016 §8 installed-software control is a fail-closed machine-root allowlist. Apply the allowlist or record the divergence as an owner-accepted residual. Decision. Derived at I9 because the owner default 2026-11-21 (b) accepted withholding user-profile paths as the privacy rule; the allowlist question is a decision, not a defect.

trigger: an operator discovers the action via the dashboard or discover_instructions
summary: 'not yet verified against a real capture' is visible in the matrix, README and changelog but not in the yaml or agent_registry descriptions an operator sees; the healthy runtime status is supported.
